en.name: Drink powders and diet mixes
en.summary: An unopened tub or sachet of drink powder keeps 18–24 months from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard, and 1–3 months once opened. These are dry powders, so nothing grows in them while they stay dry — moisture is the entire problem, and it is why the opened figure drops so sharply.
en.pantry: 18–24 months from purchase while sealed, and 1–3 months after opening, in a cool, dark, dry cupboard with the lid firmly on. Drink and diet powders are typically milk solids, sugars, starches, flavourings and vitamins, all dried to a water content low enough that microbes cannot work. Once the foil is off, the powder starts pulling moisture from the air: it cakes, the vitamins degrade faster, and any milk fat in it slowly stales. Scoop with a dry spoon, every time.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for drink powders, and the fridge is not where they belong. It is a humid environment and these powders are hygroscopic, so a tub kept cold and opened in a warm room collects condensation each time. A tightly closed tub in a dry cupboard away from the kettle does the job the published figures assume. A drink that has already been mixed with water is a different matter and should be refrigerated and drunk promptly.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either, and freezing brings the same condensation problem in a stronger form. The unopened cupboard figure already runs to a couple of years, so there is nothing to gain. If a tub has caked into a solid block, that is moisture damage rather than spoilage, though it is a sign the seal has been failing for a while.
en.thawing: Not applicable. Drink powders are a dry cupboard item and should not be frozen; anything you have already mixed belongs in the fridge instead.
spoilage: Powder caked into hard lumps that will not break up.
A stale, cardboard or rancid smell from the milk fat in the mix.
Discolouration, or a mix that no longer dissolves cleanly.
Any musty smell or visible mould in a tub that got wet.
tips: Always use a dry scoop; a wet one ruins the whole tub over time.
Write the opening date on the lid — the opened window is far shorter than the sealed one.
Buy sachets rather than a large tub if you only use it occasionally.
Keep the tub away from the kettle and the sink.

faq.q: How long do drink powders keep?
faq.a: 18–24 months from purchase while sealed, and 1–3 months once opened, stored dry with the lid closed.

faq.q: Should drink powder be kept in the fridge?
faq.a: No refrigerated timeline is published, and the fridge is humid while the powder is hygroscopic. A closed tub in a dry cupboard is better.

faq.q: My drink powder has gone lumpy. Is it still usable?
faq.a: Lumps mean moisture has got in. It is not necessarily spoiled, but the seal has been failing, so check for any musty or rancid smell before using it.

zh.name: 沖泡飲品粉與代餐粉
zh.summary: 未開封的沖泡飲品粉自購買日起，放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃可放 18～24 個月，開封後 1～3 個月。它們是乾粉，只要保持乾燥就長不出東西——問題從頭到尾都是水氣，這也是開封後數字掉得這麼兇的原因。
zh.pantry: 未開封自購買日起 18～24 個月，開封後 1～3 個月，放在陰涼、避光、乾燥的櫥櫃，蓋子要確實蓋緊。這類飲品粉與代餐粉通常是奶粉固形物、糖、澱粉、香料與維生素，乾燥到含水量低得讓微生物無法作用。鋁膜一撕開，粉就開始把空氣裡的水吸過來：結塊、維生素降解加快，裡面的乳脂也會慢慢走味。每一次都要用乾燥的量匙。
zh.fridge: 沖泡飲品粉沒有公布的冷藏期限，而冰箱也不是它該待的地方。冰箱潮濕，而這些粉又極會吸濕，所以冰過的罐子每次在溫暖房間打開，都會結一次露。蓋緊的罐子放在遠離熱水壺的乾燥櫥櫃，才符合那些公布數字的前提。已經沖泡好的飲品是另一回事，應該冷藏並盡快喝完。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據，而且結露的問題只會更嚴重。未開封本來就有將近兩年，實在賺不到什麼。如果整罐已經結成硬塊，那是受潮而不是腐敗，但也代表密封已經失效一段時間了。
zh.thawing: 不適用。飲品粉是乾燥的櫥櫃食品，不應冷凍；已經沖好的請改放冷藏。
spoilage: 配方裡的乳脂散出陳味、紙板味或油耗味。
顏色改變，或沖泡時不再溶得乾淨。
進水的罐子出現霉味或看得到霉。
tips: 一定要用乾的量匙；濕的舀一次，整罐遲早毀掉。
在蓋子上寫開封日期——開封後的窗口比未開封短太多。
偶爾才喝的話買隨身包，不要買大罐。
罐子遠離熱水壺與水槽。

faq.q: 沖泡飲品粉可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封自購買日起 18～24 個月；開封後蓋緊乾燥存放 1～3 個月。
它沒有公布的冷藏期限，而且冰箱潮濕、粉又吸濕。蓋緊放乾燥櫥櫃比較好。

faq.q: 飲品粉結塊了還能用嗎？
faq.a: 結塊代表水氣跑進去了。不一定就壞掉，但密封已經失效，使用前請先確認有沒有霉味或油耗味。
